system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

While you are in your Elemental Flux state, you may quickly send a surge of chakra through your chakra coils, giving them a burst of energy. As a bonus action, you may spend 1 Superiority Die. When you do, you gain temporary chakra points equal to twice the result and regaining the ability to mold chakra if you could not before. Your Elemental Flux state immediately ends.

Once you use this maneuver you require 10 minutes of uninterrupted meditation to recharge it. If you would use it again before recharging it, increase its Superiority Die cost by +1, each time you use it after the first.
